previous_version.new_mathematical_refinements: The phase-resolved deterministic error is now quantified as `O(log log n / log n)`, with a phase-independent constant, in a proved remark. The unnormalized remainder is `O(n log log n / (log n)^4)`. The prior-work comparison is more precise, a few formal-proof-management phrases have been simplified, and Appendix B starts with its opening proof. The fixed uniform coefficient and abstract are unchanged. Corollary 11.2 also gives a phase-independent failure-probability bound O((log n)^(2/log 2+1/2)/n) for the same remainder order, and for the fixed-coefficient consequence after an increased threshold. Its proof uses the existing explicit tail amplification and sums all four exceptional-event bounds.
previous_version.formalization_scope: Appendix H distinguishes the released full-sequence fixed-coefficient theorem and its tail-amplification route from the phase refinement and the complete written mean-positive-excess proof.
